scope: Reference-led face sculpt, nose/mouth/eye painting and stronger red brush pigment in the standalone wolf viewer. Body, curls, outline shader, coat shader and existing games retained.

head.design: Tapered face, slimmer muzzle and jaw, pointed ears; small painted nose and compact ink eyes.

faceDesign: Tapered cheeks and muzzle, taller tapered ear tips, locally relaxed lip bumps, small broad-topped painted nose and defined mouth. Compact slanted charcoal eye shapes replace amber iris circles. Red eye framing uses tapered flicks; a stronger forehead seal extends down the bridge.
pigment: Red-only edge displacement, denser wet cores, darker edge pools and sparse bristle channels concentrated at the stroke perimeter. No outline or coat shader edits.
revisionsReviewed: First face/paint render: nose and ink-eye direction retained; rejected the overlong mouth upturn and uniformly scratched red texture.
Second pass: shortened mouth and relaxed inherited lip bumps through all corrective shapes. Reduced dry channels after the pigment macro still read as repeated scratches.
Final pass: retained denser cores and edge-concentrated dry brush. Reviewed front/profile/three-quarter, open/half/closed eyes, pigment macro, Walk and Run poses.

video.source: Actual Chromium/Three.js capture with final FFmpeg captions. No generated wolf images or retouched model surfaces.
shots: 6–9 s: red pigment and sculpted-curl close-up

validation: Production build passed; source/built GLB hashes match.
Production viewer has 22 clips, 48 corrective targets, 30 fur controls and both outline passes, with no page or shader errors.
All three skin bindings are normalized, finite and nonnegative.
Native geometry has zero boundary/nonmanifold edges; body vertices outside the head adjustment are unchanged.
Passive-tail length/stability/transition checks and finite motion across all 22 clips passed.
MP4 frame count, duration and full FFmpeg decode passed.
Existing Sunward/Inkbound games and viewer ZIP unchanged.
limits: Combat clips retained rather than redesigned or exhaustively visually reviewed. These renders are an art review, not a claim that every pose matches the supplied illustrations.
